reason: A DSH-native quantitative finance toolkit centered on market-data processing, factor and strategy research, backtesting, risk analysis, paper-trading simulation, and report generation through 46 registered tools.

summaries.zh: 面向智能体的量化研究插件，提供市场数据处理、因子与策略分析、回测、风险评估、纸面交易模拟和报告生成工具。
summaries.en: An agent-oriented quantitative research plugin for market-data processing, factor and strategy analysis, backtesting, risk assessment, paper-trading simulation, and report generation.

capabilities: Fetches public market data through provider interfaces
Computes financial indicators, statistics, factors, risk metrics, options and bond analytics
Runs backtests, walk-forward research and paper-trading simulations
Generates structured chart data and research reports
Provides CLI commands for market-data and research archive browsing
Queries public GitHub and npm metadata APIs
